item.title: Nichols buys healthy drinks brand VITHIT for €75m
item.summary: Nichols, the soft drinks group behind Vimto, has acquired the functional drinks brand VITHIT for €75m (about £64m) in cash, in a move to build its presence in the fast-growing health and wellness end of the market. The AIM-listed company said the deal, struck on a debt-free, cash-free basis, would be immediately earnings-enhancing.
